user.title: HA Complete Irrigation Integration
user.description:
Pick the irrigation controller this integration should manage. Detected integrations are listed first; if your controller isn't in the list, pick "manual" and we'll show you all switches.

⚠️ Heads-up: once you create schedules here, this becomes the source of truth for irrigation. Schedules set in your controller's own app (Rachio, Hydrawise, etc.) should be paused or removed — or they'll fire alongside ours.

zones.title: Pick your irrigation zones
zones.description: We've pre-selected switches that look like real zones (excluding master valves, schedule switches, and disabled entities). Uncheck anything that isn't a zone, then submit.

aliases.title: Name your zones
aliases.description: Give each of your {zone_count} zone(s) a friendly name. Defaults to the current HA name. We'll auto-suggest a plant category (Lawn / Vegetable / Bushes / Citrus / Trees) based on the name — you can change it later in the Sensors tab.

abort.no_zones_found: No irrigation zones were found. If you're using a custom controller, make sure its switches are exposed in Home Assistant first.

rain_source_disagree.title: Rain totals disagree
rain_source_disagree.description: Tempest history ({tempest} in) and Open-Meteo ({open_meteo} in) differ by more than the agreement band over the last 72 hours. The rain lockout is using a conservative blend of {combined} in.

extend_rain_lockout.name: Extend rain lockout
extend_rain_lockout.description: Add days to a rain lockout for deep drip, flowers and garden, and/or turf. Birdbath and germination zones are not extended.

zone_type.name: Zone type
zone_type.description: Which lockout to extend. "all" extends deep drip, flowers and garden, and turf.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days to add. Default 1.
